edge.description: The edge: the dot at its left or top end, its column's letter from a at the left and its row's number from 1 at the top, then h lying across or v lying down, e.g. b2h.

oneOf.description: Draw an undrawn edge between two adjacent dots; complete a box to claim it and move again.

Action.description:
Action names its edge as text, such as "b2h": the dot at its left or top end, then h lying
across or v lying down.

Cell.description: Cell is a board position on the wire, 1-based: row 1 is the top, col 1 the left.

DrawnEvent.description:
DrawnEvent reports By's edge and the boxes it completed. Again is true when By moves again,
having completed a box with the game still on.

EdgeOrientation.description:
EdgeOrientation is the way an edge runs from its dot: across to the dot on its right, or down
to the dot below.

Line.description: Line is an edge on the wire: Row and Col are its left or top dot, 1-based from the top left.

ResultReason.description: The result reasons Dots and Boxes adds to the core's.

View.description:
View holds the board as rows from the top: Across[r][c] is the seat that drew the edge across
from dot (r, c), Down[r][c] the one down from it, and Boxes[r][c] the seat that completed that
box, each "" while undrawn or open. Across is a row of dots longer than Boxes, Down a column
wider. Scores counts each seat's boxes. Last is the latest edge drawn. LegalEdges is the
viewer's own: the undrawn edges, empty unless it is to move.
